metric.label: Combat Power
metric.note: Combat, troop, and building only exist for governors on the kingdom top-100 boards, not the full alliance.

defs.total: Governor personal power summed across every roster member.
defs.troop: Troop Power from the kingdom top-100 troop board only — not the full alliance.
defs.building: Building Power from the kingdom top-100 building board only — not the full alliance.
defs.combat: Combat = total − troop − building, summed only for governors who appear on both the troop and building top-100 boards.
defs.tc30: Furnace / town-center level ≥ 30, counted on the full alliance roster.
defs.troops: Exact troop count = troop power ÷ 66 (T10, TC 30), 50 (T9, TC 26–29), or 38 (T8, TC 24–25). Only governors on the troop top-100 board have troop power.
defs.gear: Hero / governor gear from the kingdom top-100 boards only — not the full alliance.
defs.kills: Kill count from each player page (available for the full roster).
defs.ranks: Kingdom standing from each player page — not limited to top 100.
defs.events: Mystic Trial and event stages from each player page, including ranks past 100.
